description: Conversion adjustments posted to the Google Ads API UploadConversionAdjustments method. Click uploads stay vendor/google-ads-click-conversions. Call uploads stay vendor/google-ads-call-conversions.

params.name: conversionAdjustments
params.fix_hint: Send at least one ConversionAdjustment in `conversionAdjustments`.

params.name: partialFailure
params.description: Google documents `partial_failure` as required, and the upload guides say to always send true.

params.name: conversionAction
params.description: It is the conversion action resource name, and every uploaded adjustment requires it.

params.name: adjustmentDateTime
params.description: Google documents the adjustment time with a timezone offset as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss+|-hh:mm`.

params.name: orderId
params.description: It identifies the conversion to adjust. Google documents `orderId` as the recommended identifier.

params.name: gclidDateTimePair.gclid
params.description: Google click ID plus conversion time, as an alternative to `orderId`.

params.name: gclidDateTimePair.conversionDateTime
params.description: The original conversion time when identifying via `gclidDateTimePair`. Same timestamp shape as `adjustmentDateTime`.

params.name: restatementValue.adjustedValue
params.description: The restated conversion value. Google documents it as required on `RESTATEMENT` and invalid on `RETRACTION`.
params.fix_hint: Set `restatementValue.adjustedValue` to the new conversion value.

params.name: restatementValue.currencyCode
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code for `adjustedValue`.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

rules.message: The adjustment has neither `orderId` nor `gclidDateTimePair.gclid`. Google documents one of them as required so the conversion can be identified.
The adjustment sends `gclidDateTimePair.gclid` without `conversionDateTime`. Google documents the pair together.
rules.fix_hint: Set `gclidDateTimePair.conversionDateTime` to the original conversion time.

rules.message: A `RESTATEMENT` has no `restatementValue.adjustedValue`. Google documents the restated value as required.
rules.fix_hint: Set `restatementValue.adjustedValue` to the new conversion value.

rules.message: A `RETRACTION` carries `restatementValue.adjustedValue`. Google documents that field as required on `RESTATEMENT` and invalid on a retraction.
